teams.notes: Broad Graph delegated scope (Mail/Files/Sites/Calendar/Teams, ~30 scopes). Course's own default for baseline Graph enumeration on any compromised user. Best for data mining/phishing-staging, not privesc. Fails on ARM (AADSTS65002) - use azurecli/intune instead.

intune.notes: Narrow Graph scope (Device.Read.All, ServicePrincipalEndpoint.Read.All, User.Read). Reliable for Graph/ARM. NOT pre-authorized for Storage (AADSTS65002).

office.notes: FOCI member. Broad default consent on legacy AAD Graph (graph.windows.net) specifically - use for principal ObjectId resolution and roadrecon CAP enumeration.

azurecli.notes: FOCI member. Broadly pre-authorized across nearly all first-party Azure resources, including Storage. Graph scope is directory-admin-flavored (Application.ReadWrite.All, Directory.AccessAsUser.All, User.ReadWrite.All, Group.ReadWrite.All) - best default for privesc. Default -ClientId for this script.

azurepowershell.notes: FOCI member. Broadly pre-authorized across nearly all first-party Azure resources, including Storage.
